column1: # Structural rules, for frame lines whose variable part cannot be listed (a song title, the subject
# of a report, what a reader is asked). ADR-0008 5.3 asks for rules anchored at both ends; these
# are anchored at both ends and each carries closed words at the ends: a directive and a channel of
# VOA's own, a keyword and a colon, a part-of-speech tag. The open part is bounded in length and
# can never reach outside its sentence or its line. Each rule lands with the evidence of section 5
# Tab-separated: scope, kind, flags (i = ignore case), regex.

# sentence matched against the normalised sentence (lower case, no commas, slots such as

)
#   line      matched against the whole line as written
# Lines starting with @ define a fragment, written %NAME% in the rules after it.
